current_events: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says that a supertanker carrying two million barrels of oil has sunk in the Strait of Hormuz after striking a mine
2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis, Ships attacked during the 2026 Iran war

Three Palestinians are killed and others are injured in shelling and shooting attacks by Israeli troops in various areas of the Gaza Strip, in a continuation of the violation of the ceasefire agreement signed in October 2025

The Nigerian Defence Headquarters announces that the Nigerian Army killed eight terrorists, arrested 22 additional terrorists, logistical personnel and their families, and rescued 125 kidnapping victims in various raids in the states of Adamawa, Bauchi, Yobe, and Borno between November 6 and 12
Three people are killed and several others are abducted in a cattle raid in Rabah, Sokoto State, Nigeria
Herder–farmer conflicts in Nigeria

Amid minimum wage protests by garment workers, 13 garment factories in Gazipur are shut indefinitely under the Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006 and over 50 remain closed in Savar and Ashulia, while 48 platoons of the Border Guard, Ansar, and Special Response Battalion deploy across industrial zones in Dhaka, Gazipur, and Narayanganj
2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests
Twelve people are killed and 16 others are injured when a bus carrying gas refinery workers overturns in Ilam province, Iran
Five people are injured, including three seriously, in a suspected gas explosion and fire at a Christmas market in Maredsous, Wallonia, Belgium
Eight more children in Bangladesh are reported to have died from measles, bringing the death toll past 1,314
2026 Bangladesh measles outbreak
Eight more people in Bangladesh are reported to have died from dengue fever, bringing this year's outbreak's death toll to 499

Australia and the Philippines sign a defence cooperation agreement in Manila, simplifying procedures for joint military exercises and expanding maritime surveillance, information sharing, training, and disaster response
Australia–Philippines relations

Estonia announces the closure of its three border crossings with Russia starting December 1 after eight suspects were detained over an attempted arson attack on drone manufacturer Threod Systems, which Estonian intelligence attributes to Russia's GRU
Estonia–Russia relations, Russian sabotage operations in Europe

The Jordanian State Security Court sentences three men to death for an October 23 shooting at a Greek Orthodox church in Karak Governorate that killed nine people and injured 25 others. Two accomplices receive six-year prison sentences
2026 Karak church shooting, Capital punishment in Jordan
Cape Verdeans vote to elect a president, where the main two candidates are the incumbent PAICV candidate José Maria Neves and the MpD candidate Joana Rosa
Neves wins re-election to a second five-year term with 63.8% of the vote, according to provisional results from the election commission. Rosa concedes defeat
2026 Cape Verdean presidential election

Gagauzians in Moldova vote to elect a governor and 35 members of the People's Assembly. MP Alexandr Stoianoglo and Fiodor Gagauz [ru] advance to the second round after no candidate received a majority of the vote
Non-profit fanfiction repository website Archive of Our Own is restored to limited functionality 17 days after being targeted in a cyberattack
In tennis, Kateřina Siniaková and Taylor Townsend win their second and first WTA Finals doubles titles, respectively, after defeating Sara Errani and Jasmine Paolini in the final, 6–4, 6–3
In tennis, Mirra Andreeva wins her first WTA Finals singles title after defeating Elina Svitolina in the final, 7–5, 6–3

In golf, Rory McIlroy equals Colin Montgomerie's record for the most Harry Vardon Trophies after winning his eighth Race to Dubai title, which McIlroy claimed after finishing second at the DP World Tour Championship
In women's rugby league, Australia wins its fourth consecutive World Cup title after defeating New Zealand 34–10 in the final in Brisbane
2026 Women's Rugby League World Cup, Australia–New Zealand sports rivalries
In association football, England defeats Spain 3–2 in the group stage of UEFA Nations League A to end Spain's 43-match unbeaten streak, the longest by a national team
In Canadian football, the Edmonton Elks win their 15th Canadian Football League title after beating the Montreal Alouettes 37–30 in the Grey Cup. They previously won in 2015
